title: Data Structures & Algorithms Core
description: Comprehensive DSA curriculum covering Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees, BSTs, Heaps, Graphs, Hashing, Recursion, Sorting, Searching, and Dynamic Programming with multi-language implementations.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in Data Structures & Algorithms Core.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Algorithmic Complexity & Foundations
modules.description: Asymptotic notation, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, best/average/worst case analysis, recursion trees, and master theorem.

modules.title: Arrays & Two-Pointer Techniques
modules.description: Memory layout, prefix sums, sliding window, two-pointer approach, Kadane’s algorithm, and dynamic array resizing.

modules.title: Matrix & Multi-Dimensional Grid Operations
modules.description: Row-major vs column-major order, spiral traversal, matrix rotation, search in 2D sorted matrices, and grid simulations.

modules.title: Strings & String Algorithms
modules.description: Character frequency arrays, palindromes, anagrams, sliding window on strings, KMP string matching, and Rabin-Karp hashing.

modules.title: Recursion & Backtracking
modules.description: Base cases, recursive call stack, subset generation, permutations, N-Queens problem, and Sudoku solver.

modules.title: Searching & Sorting Algorithms
modules.description: Linear search, Binary search on arrays and answer spaces, Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge Sort, Quick Sort, and Counting Sort.

modules.title: Linked Lists (Singly, Doubly & Circular)
modules.description: Node architecture, insertion, deletion, reversal, Floyd’s cycle detection algorithm, fast & slow pointers, and merging sorted lists.

modules.title: Stacks & Monotonic Stack Patterns
modules.description: LIFO principle, array & linked-list implementations, balanced parentheses, Next Greater Element, and Largest Rectangle in Histogram.

modules.title: Queues, Circular Queues & Deques
modules.description: FIFO principle, circular queue, deque, queue using stacks, sliding window maximum, and BFS queue mechanics.

modules.title: Hash Tables & Hash Maps
modules.description: Hash functions, collision resolution (chaining, open addressing), HashSet, HashMap internals, and frequency counting.

modules.title: Binary Trees & Tree Traversals
modules.description: Binary tree representation, recursive & iterative traversals (preorder, inorder, postorder, level order), height, diameter, and views (top, bottom, left, right).

modules.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
modules.description: Min-heap, max-heap, heapify, heap sort, priority queue operations, and Top K frequent elements.

modules.title: Graph Foundations & Traversals (BFS & DFS)
modules.description: Adjacency matrix vs adjacency list, Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), connected components, and cycle detection in directed/undirected graphs.

modules.title: Advanced Graph Algorithms & Shortest Paths
modules.description: Dijkstra’s algorithm, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, Prim’s & Kruskal’s Minimum Spanning Tree (MST), Topological Sort, and Kahn’s algorithm.

modules.title: Greedy Algorithms & Interval Scheduling
modules.description: Greedy choice property, Activity Selection, Fractional Knapsack, Huffman Coding, and interval merging.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming: 1D DP Patterns
modules.description: Memoization (top-down) vs Tabulation (bottom-up), Fibonacci, Climbing Stairs, House Robber, Coin Change, and Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS).

modules.title: Bit Manipulation & Binary Operations
modules.description: Bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOT, left/right shifts, bitmasking, Single Number, Counting Bits, and power of two checks.

modules.title: Tries & Disjoint Set Union (DSU)
modules.description: Prefix tree (Trie) insertion, search, prefix matching, Disjoint Set Union with path compression and union by rank, and Kruskal’s integration.
